title: How species evolve
description: A construction company landing page: species (combinations of genes) evolve left to right, 🌿 alive, ☠ extinct

blocks.title: Species S3
blocks.description: Lethal: hero video broke page speed, died in minutes

children.title: Gene: Cost calculator
children.details:
Locus: **hero section**. Visitors enter house area and type, and get an estimate before calling.

Alleles:
- **A**: one form with sliders
- **B**: a three-step quiz (type → area → finish)

Fitness: consultation requests per visitor.

children.title: Gene: Hero video
children.details:
Locus: **hero section**. Autoplay drone footage of a finished house instead of a static photo.

Broke the **page speed guardrail** (LCP over 4 s on mobile). The fast guardrail path killed the species within minutes; a skill opened a PR deleting the video code.

children.title: Gene: Cost calculator
children.description: From S1 · about to be fixed
children.details:
Locus: **hero section**. Visitors enter house area and type, and get an estimate before calling.

Alleles:
- **A**: one form with sliders
- **B**: a three-step quiz (type → area → finish)

Fitness: consultation requests per visitor.

Next: **fixation**. The calculator keeps winning in every species that carries it, so it is merged into the base and its flag removed.

children.title: Gene: Price as range
children.details:
A **nested gene**: it lives inside the calculator gene and is expressed only when the calculator is on (epistasis).

Alleles:
- **A**: exact price
- **B**: a range, "from €180k to €210k"

It is scored only on visitors who see the calculator. If the calculator went extinct, this gene would go with it.
